title: Multilingual Code-Switching Scraper Input
description: Configure the scraper to find and extract code-switched speech segments from YouTube.

searchQueries.title: YouTube Search Queries
searchQueries.description: List of search terms to find relevant YouTube videos. E.g. 'Malayalam vlog', 'Manglish interview', 'Kerala tech talk'

youtubeUrls.title: Specific YouTube URLs (optional)
youtubeUrls.description: Directly provide YouTube video URLs to process instead of or in addition to search queries.

primaryLanguage.title: Primary Language
primaryLanguage.description: The main non-English language you expect in the audio.

whisperModel.title: Whisper Model Size
whisperModel.description: Larger = more accurate but slower. 'small' recommended for most use cases.

maxVideos.title: Max Videos to Process
maxVideos.description: Maximum number of YouTube videos to download and process per run.

minCodeSwitchRatio.title: Minimum Code-Switch Ratio
minCodeSwitchRatio.description: Reject clips where one language dominates too much. 0.15 means at least 15% must be the minority language.

publishIdsOnly.title: Research Mode (IDs Only)
publishIdsOnly.description: If true, output only YouTube video IDs + timestamps (for HuggingFace dataset publishing). If false, save actual audio clips locally.
